propositions: Before any Jira mutation in a reconcile pass, a preflight must validate every mapped project and legacy_default are visible to the bridge bot via Cloud REST /rest/api/3/project/search.
Mapped-but-nonexistent project keys bypass early validation (_validate_project_key) and fail late as ACLI errors during fan-out; preflight catches them at gate.
resolve_project returns legacy_default verbatim unvalidated; when legacy_default points to invisible/wrong project, mass CREATE storms occur unguarded; preflight validates legacy_default is visible.
When projects mapping is empty, the fallback query_project is probed; if invisible or unreachable, preflight fails closed before mutation.

Hard transport faults (auth, connectivity, timeout) map to distinct TransportUnavailableError (fail-closed) vs ProjectVisibilityError (missing key); preflight aborts with actionable message naming offending keys.

Preflight is wired to run_pass_result strictly before reconcile_once only for mutating passes; skipped for preview/dry-run/non-Cloud backends; missing/transport failures convert to OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult (exit 1).
